title: Jill's Dairy — EN/SN/ND (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk fingerpicked acoustic guitar Shona Ndebele language learning warm female vocal 96bpm Zimbabwe dairy farm portrait trilingual quiet certainty dawn
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Four in the morning, the dairy doesn't wait
She moved through them easy, she knew every name
Didn't need to think about what comes next
The rhythm was hers, the morning was hers

[Verse 2 - Shona, with English translations]
Nechina mangwanani, dairy hairinde (Four in the morning, the dairy doesn't wait)
Akafamba pakati pazo zvakapfava, aiziva mazita ese (She moved through them easily, she knew every name)
Akasazodavira zvaaizofanira kuita (She didn't need to think about what comes next)
Mutambo waiva wake, mangwanani aiva ake (The rhythm was hers, the morning was hers)
Vanhu vanotaura nehupenyu hwakaoma (People talk about the hard life)
Sezvingadai zvichida kutsanangurirwa avo vakaraira (As though it needs explaining to those who lived it)
Jill akangonyemwerera ndokudzoka kubasa (Jill just nodded and went back to work)
Akaita semudzimai asingadi kunyengetedzwa (The kind of woman who doesn't need convincing)

[Chorus - Ndebele, with English translations]
IDairy kaJill (Jill's dairy)
Emahoreni andulela ukuvuka komhlaba (In the hours before the world wakes)
IDairy kaJill (Jill's dairy)
Lapho umsebenzi weqiniso wenziwa ebumnyameni (Where the real work gets done in the dark)
IDairy kaJill (Jill's dairy)
Lapho uqiniseko kuyisiko lasekuseni (Where certainty is a morning habit)
Izinkomo ziyabuya (And the cows come home)
UJill usekhona (Because Jill is there)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Some people hold families together quietly — Jill did it quietly
Shona: Vamwe vanhu vanobata mhuri pamwe chete vakanyarara — Jill akaita izvozvo (Some hold families quietly — Jill did that)
Ndebele: Abanye abantu babamba imindeni ndawonye ngokuthula — uJill wakwenza lokho (Some hold families quietly — Jill did that)

[Outro - all three]
English: Jill's dairy — still running in the family it made
Shona: Dairy raJill — richiri kumhanyiswa nemhuri ravakatanga (Jill's dairy — still running in the family it made)
Ndebele: IDairy kaJill — isasebenza emndenini eyawuqoqa (Jill's dairy — still running in the family it made)
